name: gsdock
description: GoodSync Connect Server Runs the GoodSync Connect Linux server to store your backups. Valid GoodSync Connect account required. The WebUI credentials are the same as your GoodSync Connect account credentials that you set as GS_USER and GS_PWD

paths.name: GoodSync Connect Backups Data Path
paths.description: Holds backup data. Should place this outside of appdata, in a dedicated backups share

paths.name: GS Server Configuration Folder
paths.description: Holds settings.tix and users.tix config files

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: WebUI Configuration can be accessed through this port. Credentials are same as GS Connect credentials.

variables.name: GS_ID
variables.description: (optional) GS Server Name. Will be container ID if blank.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
